archetypes.name: dyn-oos-cap
archetypes.rationale: Issue-cap behavior now depends on Python parser parity and atomic output handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/file_oos.py and python/test_file_oos.py for parity with the retired issue-cap fixture behavior. Focus on missing inputs, same input/output rejection, malformed OOS batches, invalid env exit codes, in-place preservation, stale output deletion, UTF-8 truncation, and file-reference preservation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-retired-paths
archetypes.rationale: The change deletes six shipped script/contract files and relies on inventory cleanup.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the retired-script migration surface. Check python/migrated-scripts.tsv, scripts/residual-bash-paths.txt, agent-lint.toml, docs, and skill prose for stale retired-path references or missing reachability for the Python replacement. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
